exposure: Levobupivacaine in Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) block
outcome: time to first rescue analgesia requirement
finding: The addition of Dexmedetomidine to Levobupivacaine in TAP block significantly increased the duration of analgesia and decreased the total requirement for rescue analgesia in patients after Caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that adding Dexmedetomidine to TAP block prolonged analgesia specifically for patients undergoing Caesarean delivery.
